basis: Benign lymphocytic infiltration confined to skin; lymphocyte morphology alone does not establish systemic blood disease or autoimmunity.
Benign blood-vessel neoplasm arising in the ocular choroid.
Schwann-cell/nerve-sheath neoplasm; variable anatomical sites do not support another organ across the umbrella.
Nonpsychiatric primary disorder of thirst and water balance; electrolyte complications are not universal.
Defined by congenital cardiac malformations, particularly atrioventricular septal defects.
Anthracycline-induced myocardial disease; treatment causation does not exclude the organ defining this concept.
Meningeal neoplasm of the central nervous system.
Herpes simplex infection directly affects skin; ocular disease is not established by ambiguous eyelid synonyms.
Nonautoimmune thyroid hyperfunction; developmental and motor delay reported in 30-79%. Tachycardia, tremor and diarrhea alone do not establish organ damage.
Destruction of axons and myelin distal to nerve injury; weakness reflects nerve dysfunction.
Malignancy of the auditory system; acoustic-nerve origin applies only to a subtype.
Ovarian reproductive-organ neoplasm; endocrine dysfunction is not defining across this umbrella.
MPEG1 immunodeficiency with structural bronchiectasis in 4/4. Isolated hearing, skin and gastrointestinal reports do not establish cohort-wide involvement.
Sperm count, motility and morphology disorder causing male infertility; purely reproductive.
B-cell lymphoid malignancy; lymphoma warrants the immune mechanism axis. No common extranodal damage is established.
Melanoma without a specified anatomical site is assigned the usual cutaneous origin; mixed cell morphology alone does not establish ocular origin.
Chronic gonococcal infection of the cervix; the reproductive location has no anatomical axis.
Congenital malformations of the palate, tongue and oral structures; digital abnormalities are only variably reported.
Neurodevelopmental syndrome; tooth agenesis 2/2, hearing impairment 1/2 and strabismus 1/2. Joint/digital abnormalities omitted under the four-axis cap.
Defining eye malformations, obesity/hypogonadism and intellectual disability; corresponding phenotypes occur in 30-79%.
Malignant apical lung primary. Associated Pancoast syndrome is optional; common destructive nerve or bone invasion is not established for the entire concept.
Developmental delay and skeletal malformations define the syndrome; blepharophimosis 80-99%; congenital cardiac defects occur in roughly 35%.
Mitochondrial metabolic disease; seizures/developmental delay, rhabdomyolysis and dilated cardiomyopathy each reported in 1/2 patients.
Fibroblastic/myofibroblastic soft-tissue neoplasm with variable visceral sites; inflammatory infiltrates do not establish an immune-mediated disease.
Defining lacrimal, auditory and dental/salivary defects; digital skeletal malformations are a major criterion, with thumb phalanx duplication in 11/14.
